items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Confidence Is Back, But Earnings Show the Consumer Is Being Picky
items.summary: Q2 earnings from Domino's, Darden, Williams-Sonoma, Best Buy and Home Depot reveal uneven consumer spending, with affluent shoppers outpacing cautious middle- and lower-income buyers.

items.title: 3 Stocks With Solid Yields and Sustainabale Payouts Boost Dividends Once Again

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock to Research Further and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks have the best odds of scaling into $100 billion corporations thanks to their tested business models and large addressable markets. But the many opportunities in front of them attract significant competition, spanning from industry behemoths with seemingly infinite resources to small, nimble players with chips on their shoulders.
